title: suderra.edge-release.v1 release statement
description: Signed by the edge-release key, one per (arch, board_profile) (ADR-048 DEC-3.1, DEC-8.5, DEC-23). Tenant-independent by design (DEC-22): the device-bound provisioning manifest decides which device runs it. arch, agent_profile and cargo_features must agree with boards.json for board_profile, and artifact.name with artifact-naming.json.

security_version.description: Monotonic integer compared against the device rollback floor; semver strings are never compared (DEC-2.5).

cargo_features.description: Exact cargo feature set of the build, sorted, no duplicates.

binary_digest.description: Digest of the single suderra-agent member; verify-current re-checks it before every start (DEC-1.5).

min_os_version.description: Oldest OS VERSION_ID this release runs on (statements.json compatibility, DEC-23).

agent_abi.description: Must lie inside the SUDERRA_AGENT_ABI range the OS publishes in /etc/os-release (statements.json compatibility, DEC-23).

required_kernel_config.description: Kernel config symbols the agent needs on this board; each must have a =y or =m line in the OS's /etc/suderra/kernel-config (statements.json compatibility, DEC-23).

provenance.description: Digest of the release provenance document; the device does not trust provenance, the cloud admits it before any manifest names the release (DEC-3.8, DEC-20).
